name: International Space Station
tagline: Not everything left in orbit is forgotten: this remarkable outpost is still home to people and discovery.
imageAlt: Illustrated archive portrait of International Space Station
credit: Original editorial illustration created for the Left Behind archive.

beats.goal: Serve as a permanently crewed laboratory for science, technology demonstrations and international cooperation in low Earth orbit.
beats.achieved: The station has supported thousands of experiments, long-duration crew missions, Earth observation and technology testing across multiple partner agencies.
beats.ending: The ISS has not ended. Its future deorbit is planned for the end of its operational life; the exact schedule is subject to programme decisions and technical readiness.
beats.now: The station remains crewed and operational. It is maintained through visiting spacecraft, cargo vehicles, spacewalks and regular system upgrades.
beats.learned: The ISS demonstrates how complex international infrastructure can be assembled, maintained and used in orbit for decades.
